version.description:
Auth for Tesla gets you a working Tesla API token in seconds — then helps you check it, prove it, and put it to work. Sign in once with your Tesla account and your refresh and access tokens are one tap from the clipboard, ready for Shortcuts, scripts, home-automation tools, or your own app.

A TOKEN TOOL, NOT A CAR APP
Auth for Tesla doesn't drive your car, wake it up, or try to replace the Tesla app. It does one job well: hand you a valid OAuth token and make it easy to use.

ONE TAP TO COPY
• Refresh token and access token side by side, each copied with a single tap.
• A live "Valid for…" countdown on the access token, and a clear "Long-lived" badge on the refresh token.
• Refresh both with one button — or with ⌘R on Mac.
• Turn on token details for issuer, audiences, scopes, region, and expiry at a glance.

YOUR PASSWORD STAYS WITH TESLA
You sign in on Tesla's own website in a secure in-app browser. Your username and password never pass through this app or any developer-run server. Multi-factor sign-in works as usual, and sign-in survives a hop to your password manager.

PROVE IT WORKS
Test Your Token runs a few read-only calls against the Owners or Fleet API — your account, your vehicles, your scopes — so you know the token works end to end before you paste it anywhere.

DEVELOPER TOOLS BUILT IN
• JWT Inspector — paste any token, or pick a stored one, and see the decoded header, payload, scopes, expiry, and a clear Valid/Expired status.
• Snippet Exporter — copy the active token as ready-to-run cURL, HTTPie, Swift, or Python, bearer header included.

OWNERS API AND FLEET API
• Owners API — the token most Tesla-compatible apps and Shortcuts ask for.
• Fleet API — Tesla's official API for developers with a partner account, with the region (North America, Europe, Asia Pacific, Middle East, China) detected for you.

EVERY ACCOUNT, ONE TAP APART
Keep personal, work, and test accounts side by side for each API. Switch, rename, and add accounts without signing in again.

SIRI & SHORTCUTS
Get and Refresh actions for both APIs appear automatically in the Shortcuts app and work with Siri, and each can target a specific account. Build automations that always have a fresh token.

IPHONE, IPAD AND MAC
The same tools on every device, in a Liquid Glass design.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Tokens are stored encrypted in your iCloud Keychain and sync only across your own devices. No analytics, no tracking, no third-party SDKs.

OPEN SOURCE
Every line of code is public and auditable at github.com/TeslaBuds/AuthAppForTesla.

Disclaimer: Auth for Tesla is an independent app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Tesla, Inc. Use at your own risk. No guarantee of proper function is given. You are solely responsible for any changes to your vehicle caused by the use of this app.

Made in Denmark.

version.whatsNew:
Auth for Tesla 3.0.1 turns the app into a real developer cockpit for Tesla tokens.

NEW — Tools tab
• JWT Inspector — paste or pick any token and see decoded header, payload, scopes, and a valid/expired status. No more jwt.io detours.
• Snippet Exporter — copy your active token as ready-to-run cURL, HTTPie, Swift URLRequest, or Python requests.
• Test Your Token — run real, read-only Owners or Fleet API diagnostic calls to confirm end-to-end that your token works, including a scopes inspection.

NEW — Multiple accounts
• Keep personal, work, and test profiles side by side per API.
• One-tap switching, rename and add accounts at any time.
• Logout / 'Delete This Account' now confirms before wiping the token, so a misfired tap won't force a re-sign-in.
• Logout deletes only the active profile and falls through to the next.

NEW — Token cards with live status
• The Access Token card shows a live 'Valid for X' countdown badge that flips to red 'Expired' when it lapses.
• The Refresh Token card gets a quiet 'Long-lived' badge so you can tell the two apart at a glance.
• 'Show token details' opens a clean tabular breakdown of issuer, audiences, scopes, region, locale, and expiry.
• Auto-detected region (NA, EU, AP, ME, CN) on every Fleet token, so you know exactly which Tesla endpoint you're talking to.

DESIGN — Liquid Glass throughout
• Every screen rebuilt around iOS 26's Liquid Glass — glass cards, capsule buttons, consistent corner radii and rhythm across home, Tools, About, and Login.
• Toast notifications are proper glass capsules now, lifted clear of the floating tab bar.
• Fleet API form fields are subtle glass capsules instead of hard-black rounded rectangles.
• Account menu is a real glass button with a proper hit target, not just a tappable icon.

SIRI & SHORTCUTS
• All four token actions (Get / Refresh for both APIs) appear automatically in Shortcuts.
• Each intent now accepts an optional Account parameter so a Shortcut can target a specific stored profile.
• Fixes a long-standing bug where 'Refresh Fleet API Token' would refresh the Owners token by mistake when both were signed in.

UNDER THE HOOD
• Sign-in now survives a hop to your password manager — the auth web view stays put with whatever you'd typed, instead of reloading back to the email step.
• Token storage refactored around named profiles with seamless migration of any existing single-token install.
• Lots of small UX polish across the home views, Tools detail screens, and login flow.

review.notes:
Auth for Tesla is a token-management utility for developers and power users. It performs OAuth sign-in to Tesla's official endpoints and lets the user copy, inspect, and reuse the resulting tokens — it does not drive vehicles or contact Tesla on the user's behalf.

A real Tesla account is provided for review (it has no vehicles linked):
  Username: noteslavehicles@kimhansen.dk
  Password: cjNZnCfEhfMYHYwn2fyvwkHm

What to verify:

1. OWNERS API SIGN-IN — Tap the Owners API tab → Sign in with Tesla. Sign-in happens entirely inside Tesla's own auth.tesla.com web view; the app never sees the password. After sign-in, the home view shows the active profile, the access token's live 'Valid for X' countdown, the refresh token's 'Long-lived' badge, detected region, and the tokens themselves (tap to copy). 'Show token details' opens a tabular breakdown of issuer, audiences, scopes, etc.

2. PASSWORD-MANAGER HOP (new) — During sign-in, type any text into Tesla's email field, press the Home button, then re-open the app. The auth web view stays on the email step with your typed text intact.

3. DELETE CONFIRMATION (new) — From the Owners API home, tap the account icon → 'Logout' (or 'Delete This Account' if multiple profiles exist). A confirmation dialog appears before the token is removed.

4. TOOLS TAB — Three diagnostic tools:
   • JWT Inspector — pre-filled with the active token. Decodes header, payload, scopes, expiry, with a Valid/Expired status badge. Also accepts any pasted JWT (e.g. from jwt.io) — no sign-in required.
   • Snippet Exporter — generates ready-to-paste cURL, HTTPie, Swift URLRequest, or Python snippets for the active token.
   • Test Your Token — runs read-only calls against Tesla's API (/api/1/users/me + /api/1/vehicles). The demo account has no vehicles, so the vehicles call returns '0 vehicles' — that is correct.

5. MULTIPLE ACCOUNTS — Account icon → 'Add Another Account' signs in with a second Tesla account in a fresh profile. The same menu switches, renames, or deletes profiles. With multiple profiles, the destructive action becomes 'Delete This Account' (deletes only the active profile and falls through to the next).

6. FLEET API — Requires partner credentials (Client ID, Client Secret, Redirect URI) issued by Tesla via dev.tesla.com. The review demo account is Owners-API only and cannot exercise the Fleet API sign-in path; the screen still renders and validates input. The form fields are subtle glass capsules — intentional, not a rendering bug.

7. SIRI & SHORTCUTS — About tab lists four built-in actions (Get / Refresh for both APIs) that appear in Shortcuts and work with Siri. Each intent accepts an optional Account parameter so a Shortcut can target a specific stored profile.

PRIVACY — No analytics, no developer-run servers. Tokens are stored encrypted in the device keychain and synced via the user's own iCloud Keychain. Source code is publicly auditable at github.com/TeslaBuds/AuthAppForTesla.

This app is not affiliated with, endorsed, sponsored, or approved by Tesla, Inc. Tesla is a trademark of Tesla, Inc.
